input.objective: Create a polished, genuinely watchable 38 to 42 second promo video for The Hooks Store, https://the-hooks-store.sites.imd.fun, a storefront where anyone builds a Uniswap v4 hook from blocks and launches it through IMD's swarm. Deliver the finished MP4, 1920x1080, 30 fps, H.264 with AAC audio, made for X, plus a 1920x1080 poster frame. WHAT IT IS, in the store's own words: stack blocks (Swap fee, Pause switch, Cooldown, Allowlist opening, Buyback jar, Anti-sniper window and more), the Builder turns every block into an exact sentence the swarm receives, IMD's swarm writes, tests and audits the hook with four auditors and a judge, then deploys it, usually in 30 to 90 minutes, for 0.5 IMD once; the hook gets its own page with its addresses and owner controls; live launches become proven blueprints the next launch starts from; a creator can feature a hook on the store for 0.1 IMD per 24 hours. CREATIVE DIRECTION: pixel storefront motion design, calm and confident, one coherent visual story, no stock footage, no generic crypto imagery, no rockets, no charts implying price, no mascots, no people. Everything must read with sound off: short on-screen lines, each held long enough to read. Quiet chiptune-flavoured instrumental music and a few soft pixel sound effects; absolutely no voiceover, narration or text-to-speech. Avoid a static slideshow, repetitive zooms, flashing effects and tiny captions. BRAND AND SOURCES: use only the store's own art. Inspect the live site (Store, Builder, a hook page such as https://the-hooks-store.sites.imd.fun/#hook/1/0xbe2a3bbe001cb0aa2fd3dafd7260eb579e10d948aad6aa62c80717ed5c0adf1c, My hooks). Palette: paper #f4ecd8, paper-2 #e9dfc6, paper-3 #fff8e6, ink #15130f, pine #1f4d3a, the #AD gold #b8902a, the red #b3261e for findings only. Fonts: Press Start 2P for titles, labels and pills; Atkinson Hyperlegible for sentences; JetBrains Mono for numbers and addresses (all three are Google Fonts; the site also serves them under /fonts/). The logo is the drawn pixel fishing hook in the site's top bar next to THE HOOKS STORE. The landing's pixel pond with reeds, a hat and birds is the store's signature scene; recreate its feel, do not screen-record the site. Download assets into the workspace first; media commands use local relative paths. Do not connect a wallet or send any transaction. STORYBOARD (refine pacing and wording, keep the facts): 0-4s hook: the pixel pond at dusk, the fishing-hook logo drops into the water, title THE HOOKS STORE, line "A Uniswap v4 hook. Built from blocks." 4-10s problem: a wall of Solidity text dissolves into six labelled blocks; line "Hooks are code. You don't have to write it." 10-18s the Builder: blocks snap into a stack (Swap fee 1%, Pause switch, Cooldown 30 s), the hook card on the right fills in tile by tile, then the exact-text sheet slides up; lines "Stack blocks." then "Every block becomes an exact sentence the swarm receives." 18-26s the swarm: a small pixel diagram, write, test, four auditors and a judge, deploy, each node lighting up in turn with a progress bar; lines "Written, tested, audited. Then deployed." and "Usually 30 to 90 minutes. 0.5 IMD, once." 26-32s live: the hook page, the LIVE pill, three address rows filling in, the owner controls panel with Pause swaps and a reading; line "Your hook, live, with its own control panel." 32-37s proven and featured: the catalog cards with PROVEN pills and the line "Live hooks become blueprints. The next launch starts from audited code."; then the featured strip scrolling with an #AD card and "Feature yours: 0.1 IMD a day." 37-42s close: the pond again, the hook resting in the water, the URL the-hooks-store.sites.imd.fun large and readable, line "Cast yours." GUARDRAILS: no claims beyond those facts; no "safe", "guaranteed", "risk-free" or returns; no other projects, tokens or logos; no price of IMD; the words "audited" and "four auditors and a judge" are accurate and may be used. Deliver artifacts/hooks-store-promo.mp4 and artifacts/poster.png, plus README.md with production notes, tools used, music source and licence, and what you could not do.
